findings.finding: One exact-head workflow executes the benchmark, solver, contract, syntax, import, build and hygiene gates. Retained production response, stress, external code authority and replay evidence remain separate qualification inputs.

An executable anti-drift gate requires T3, T6, pure shear, plane-stress cantilever, Kirsch and production lug in that exact order. The pure-bending panel remains supplemental and cannot substitute for the cantilever.

One exact-head registry binds four independent closed-form benchmark oracles, one independent engineering-theory cantilever oracle and two frozen production convergence/location definitions. Production output cannot generate expected values, select coordinates or set tolerances.
The governed 64/256/1024/4096 annular T6 ladder is checked for geometry, Jacobians, midside placement, symmetry, connectivity and feature sets.
Material, load and restraint mapping coverage remains dependent on retained production execution.
The governed T3 patch covers plane stress and plane strain, exact displacement, stress, energy, load parity, equilibrium and deterministic replay.
The T6 patch covers distorted geometry, rigid motions, scaling, rotation and Jacobian rejection.
The governed pure-shear receipt covers affine displacement, tensor and derived stress, energy, load-path parity, equilibrium and replay.

The governed plane-stress cantilever consumes a frozen Timoshenko-beam oracle and retains four-level displacement convergence, reactions, equilibrium, strain energy, external work, orientation sensitivity and deterministic replays.
The T6 pure-bending panel remains supplemental formulation evidence and is not a cantilever substitute.

The 64/256/1024/4096 production ladder has frozen force, moment and strain-energy contracts. Global convergence is evaluated on the finest three governed levels, 256/1024/4096, while the 64-element result is retained for trend audit.
Dense Cholesky is retained for small systems and deterministic CSR/Jacobi-PCG is used above 1536 DOFs. The governed 4096-element production run is not yet retained at the final exact-head SHA.

Element-local probes now evaluate the T6 displacement gradient directly at each frozen coordinate using retained nodal displacements and the retained element constitutive matrix. Integration-point extrapolation, nodal projection and cross-element averaging are prohibited.
A governed T6 Kirsch benchmark uses frozen off-boundary probes and fixed-coordinate GCI against a closed-form oracle.
Two standalone lug probes and a five-station radial path remain frozen before stress observation and map uniquely at all four production levels.

The production stress receipt requires zone-specific GCI over the finest three governed levels at every frozen coordinate using direct T6 point recovery. No production stress PASS is claimed until retained execution proves every location.
The fail-closed code-basis contract consumes direct-point stress evidence, but no externally approved governing code, edition, allowable, classification or load combination is supplied.
The custody contract requires exactly three distinct exact-head replay bundles with identical evidence, stdout, stderr and required report hashes. No repository replay PASS is claimed.
